description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing the 'Information' module within the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for rendering the module's configuration page and saving configuration settings.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Information' module in OpenCart admin. Handles displaying the module settings page and processing save actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the module settings page with breadcrumbs, header, footer, and current configuration data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration settings, including permission checks and JSON response indicating success or error.
